cohort.source_information: original public 7x7 pixels, direction, mission, own selected action and successor public observation, reward, true terminal; no world pose/map/inventory or external action
cohort.cold_memory: independent within-family across 3 source episodes per actor, never across roles/families
cohort.source_lineage_limitation: Checks known prior seed declarations and MG35 parent reachable research tree, cannot certify disconnected private branches
cohort.resource_boundary: equal source action/observation cap; host wall+CPU optional; full Go child CPU/RSS parity is not qualified

conventional_model.type: independent empirical tabular selected-action transition/reward model with finite-depth optimistic backup
conventional_model.state_key: canonical sha256 of original public image, direction and literal mission
conventional_model.action_counts: selected action only, per-state/action successor frequency; never counterfactual env.step
conventional_model.reward_backup: observed own positive terminal transitions only, future terminal estimate bounded; unknown actions receive confidence bonus
conventional_model.deterministic_tie: sha256 current public first byte modulo 7
conventional_model.prohibition: no hard-coded key-door-target search route or env-specific goal scripting

outcomes.primary: independent original goal-positive episode count in each unfamiliar family (UnlockPickup, BlockedUnlockPickup, KeyCorridor)
outcomes.target_discovery: actual before-action target-facing frames AND distinct public target-facing contexts per family/role
outcomes.action_conditioned: actual selected target pickup attempt/effect; visible locked door and selected toggle/open effects separate; actual termination/reward
outcomes.nondegeneracy: each control action histogram and genuine step effect; corrected UCB+RR exact source retained
outcomes.resource: selected source steps/role; no native compute/energy equivalence claim

require_all: candidate positive original terminal goal in >=2 unfamiliar families
candidate positive unfamiliar original goal episodes exceeds every listed comparator
candidate >=1 actual exact mission-target pickup effect
candidate >=1 positive goal in UnlockPickup OR BlockedUnlockPickup
dev_acceptance.never: DEV success alone does not warrant native integration or scientific first-use
